name: chatup
description: ChatUp - a real-time web messaging application

scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate -w @chatup/server && npm run db:seed -w @chatup/server
scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
scripts.load:smoke: npm run load:bundle && k6 run -e K6_PROFILE=smoke -e K6_BASE_URL=${K6_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:4000} load-test/k6/dist/chatup.load.js
scripts.load: npm run load:bundle && k6 run -e K6_PROFILE=full -e K6_BASE_URL=${K6_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:4000} load-test/k6/dist/chatup.load.js
